data.message: I commit to request 18 tons this month and invite each of you to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. State your exact intended catch and any conditions. Versus 10, 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all 18 leaves 50, but recovery to 500 isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation.
